title: Translation estimates plus uniformly Cauchy mollifications imply local Cauchy in measure
statement:
Let N ∈ ℕ and let (F_k)_{k∈ℕ} be L^N-null-measurable subsets of ℝ^N. Let (ρ_m)_{m∈ℕ} be continuous, compactly supported functions ℝ^N → ℝ with ρ_m ≥ 0, ∫ρ_m dL^N = 1 and support ρ_m ⊆ B̄_{1/(m+1)}(0). Write v_{m,k}(y) := ∫_{F_k} ρ_m(y − z) dz and S_h := {y : y + h ∈ S}. Assume:
(i) for every R ∈ ℕ there are C ∈ ℝ and k₀ ∈ ℕ such that L^N(B_R(0) ∩ ((F_k)_h Δ F_k)) ≤ ofReal(C|h|) for all k ≥ k₀ and all h ∈ ℝ^N with |h| ≤ 1;
(ii) for every m ∈ ℕ and ε > 0 there is k₀ such that |v_{m,k}(y) − v_{m,l}(y)| ≤ ε for all k, l ≥ k₀ and all y ∈ B̄_m(0).
Then for every R ∈ ℕ and every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is k₀ such that L^N(B_R(0) ∩ (F_k Δ F_l)) ≤ ε for all k, l ≥ k₀.
